title: Krea 2 Turbo (public line)
description: 8-step distilled Krea 2 Turbo text-to-image worker: one prompt in, one 1K PNG out. The schedule is pinned at 8 steps / CFG 0, and the age rule runs before any GPU work.

input.name: Checkpoint
input.description: Either a Hugging Face repo id such as krea/Krea-2-Turbo (downloaded and cached on first load) or a path to a .safetensors file already on the worker. A repo id with several checkpoints must name the file as org/name::file.safetensors.

input.name: Hugging Face cache
input.description: Where the checkpoint, the Qwen3-VL encoder and the Qwen-Image VAE are cached after the first download. Point it at a network volume to avoid paying for them on every cold worker.
